description:
Approximate Dimensions: Unit A, Building, 70 Parking Space 70, Covered Bridge Condominium, No. 5, Tax Lot(s) 70.01, Tax Block 423, Township of Manalapan, Monmouth County
That Unit No. A, in Building, No. 70 Together with Parking Space 70-AS in "Covered Bridge Condominium, No. 5", 70 Overlook Way, Township of Manalapan, Monmouth County, New Jersey, Tax Map Lot 70.01, Block 423, together with an undivided 0.65352 percent in the Common Elements appurtenant thereto, as may be amended from time to time, is located substantially in accordance with said location of Unit No. A, in Building, No. 70 Together with Parking Space 70-AS in "Covered Bridge Condominium, No. Five" as described in Master Deed for "Covered Bridge Condominium, No. Five" recorded in the Office of the Monmouth County Clerk on October 2,1975 in Deed Book 4212, Page 819 as the same may now or hereafter be lawfully amended.
No. of feet to the Nearest Cross Street: Approximately 1056 feet from Amberly Drive
**UPSET AMOUNT $285,000.00**
*PROPERTY IS VACANT*
**Subject to unpaid real estate taxes 3rd & 4th qtrs. 2024 and 1st quarter of 2025 in the amount of $3,829.85 as of March 15, 2025**
This sale is also further subject to possessory rights of any tenant or party residing in the property. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation. To ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon
